title: Running Sum
description:
Given a list of numbers, return a new list where each element is the sum of all previous elements up to and including that index (prefix sum).

**Example:**
```
running_sum([1, 2, 3, 4]) → [1, 3, 6, 10]
running_sum([1, 1, 1, 1, 1]) → [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
running_sum([3, 1, 4, 1, 5]) → [3, 4, 8, 9, 14]
```
hint: Maintain a running total. For each element, add it to the total and append total to the result.
